newsitem.title: USA: USTR chief concerned by Japan surplus rise with US.
newsitem.headline: USTR chief concerned by Japan surplus rise with US.

text.p: U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky voiced concern on Friday about a renewed rise in Japan's trade surplus with the United States.

"The concern we have right now is that we see an upturn in Japan's trade surplus with us and at the same time we see a downturn in some of our major exports, for example, vehicles," she told a meeting of Women in International Trade.
Barshefsky said that Washington, from President Clinton on down, has made clear to Tokyo that it does not want to see a significant rise in Japan's surplus with the United States.
